identification: Two modern Australian standard reflective aluminium rail-crossing signs (AS 1742.7 type): a red rectangular 'RAILWAY CROSSING' crossbuck sign (R6-24 type, roughly 120x80cm judging by proportion) and a white square 'LOOK FOR TRAINS' supplementary plate (black border, roughly 60x60cm). Retroreflective sheeting faces, rounded corners, not enamel, not railway-company cast or enamel signage. Likely late 20th / 21st century decommissioned road-authority signs.

viewing_check: Measure the crossbuck (R6-24 standard is about 1200x800) and the plate; check backs for authority/maker stamp and date (e.g. DIER Tas, year), bends, bolt holes, scratches in the reflective film (light scratches visible on red field left of centre).
